Leaf_Blight.quote: Discoloured patches develop on the leaves. These soon turn brown

Initial symptoms are frequently observed on young leaf margins and apices, with foliar symptoms characterized by grayish to brown, semicircular or irregular shaped lesions, often surrounded by pale yellow zones up to 9 mm in diameter.

Red_Leaf_Spot.quote: On the upper surface of the leaf, the spot is dark red-brown to purple-black, up to 25 mm in diameter.
The most extreme symptoms produce necrotic patches on the stem.
